# Data freshness and availability {#data-status}

The analysis date for this publication is **`r book_date()`**. Retrieval timestamps
below use UTC. The latest observation is the provider's most recent dated row;
it may precede the analysis date or contain a missing value. Monthly and quarterly
series naturally update less often than market prices.

Essential missing inputs stop publication and leave the previous book available.
An optional series that could not be retrieved is marked unavailable and excluded
from this build. Historical comparisons use the dates and data preparation
described in their chapters.

```{r source-status, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
source_status <- book_source_status()
if (nrow(source_status)) {
  print(knitr::kable(source_status, row.names = FALSE))
} else {
  cat("No remote observations were requested in this build.\n")
}
book_write_manifest()
```

The Danish fund-tax catalogue is a separately maintained, dated snapshot. Its
classification dates and supporting links appear in the catalogue itself; they
are not refreshed by rendering this book.
